cultural.vision_reason: The photo shows a large crowd of Sidama men in traditional dress (leopard-skin cape, beaded/fringed garments) holding spears and large leather shields, gathered for the Fichche Chambalaala new year celebration in Hawassa — a clear documentary image of Sidama festival dress and material culture.
